required_units: The physical/geometric reason navigation remained incomplete is unresolved because the costmap cell payload is absent.
The action aborted at 70.860 s, aligned within 0.860 s of the exact configured 70.0 s BT deadline.
Deadline alignment supports a bounded execution-mechanism reconstruction but the missing terminal BT transition prevents claiming the final timeout tick was directly observed.
Delivered odometry records 6.949 m maximum forward progress and 2.705 m maximum lateral deviation toward an 18.0 m goal.
The answer must not classify direct-route obstruction, retained-grid connectivity, global feasibility, or a unique physical obstacle.
A hash-checked costmap cell payload synchronized with planned paths is the decisive next physical diagnostic check.
prohibited_claims: The direct route was obstructed or clear.
The retained grid was connected or disconnected.
A named physical obstacle caused the failure.
The terminal timeout transition was directly observed.
The declared costmap hash verifies cell values that were not retained.

limits: The terminal BT transition was not retained.
The costmap hash is declared metadata and cannot verify absent cells.
Delivered observations are not proof of every value consumed internally by Nav2.
Evaluator-only scenario and obstacle identities are unavailable.
